Ruling: scope; i1040sd p. 11, 28% Rate Gain Worksheet, line 4: "Enter the total of any collectibles gain reported to you on: • Form 1099-DIV, box 2d; • Form 2439, box 1d; and • Schedule K-1 from a partnership, S corporation, estate, or trust." Form 2439 and Schedule K-1 amounts: sd.other_forms ("Are there gains or losses from (or that belong on) Forms 4797, 2439, 6252, 4684, 6781 or 8824, or capital gains or losses on a Schedule K-1? ...") refuses them, reaching Form 1040 line 7a through Schedule D lines 7, 15 and 16 (as the earlier rulings of this line). Within scope line 4 is Form 1099-DIV box 2d alone. The restatement now names the box 2a condition of the box 2d input: f1099div p. 5, "Box 2d. Shows the portion of the amount in box 2a that is 28% rate gain", so box 2d is zero when box 2a is. Project retained.
